answer: Canyon yarrow milestone bond: each identity stakes 70 credits on a canyon garden of yarrow. Three milestones gate it: sprouts, bloom, seed harvest, auditor-checked on a public table. Miss one or reuse another garden's yarrow and the bond burns. Filing: 38 plus 6 per extra identity; 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000, gain at most 40 each. Borrowed yarrow fails: each crop carries its garden's soil tag. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep it.
